# The Library of Alexandria's shorthand slots (docs/ALEXANDRIA.md).
# One line per base slot: a slot number, its shorthand, the block entry it
# names, and its state. Append only: a slot is never renumbered, reused or
# deleted. A slot whose entry is withdrawn stays, marked "retired", so every
# program that names it still gets an answer (a refusal), never another
# block. Slots 1..0xFFFF are the base; 0x10000 and up are community overlays,
# people and models: lower case, digits and "_", at most 31 bytes. The
# namespaces are mem crypto drv logic wire num fin prob strat time swarm text.
# tools/alexandria/build_index.py --assign appends a line for every block
# entry that has none; --check fails when one is missing.
